{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The gravest terror threat is a nuclear attack made possible by nuclear proliferation, requiring a comprehensive strategy for reducing the world's nuclear stockpiles and preventing the spread of those armaments.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. can lead the effort to reduce nuclear stockpiles and prevent proliferation only if it maintains an effective strategic arsenal at a level sufficient to fulfill its deterrent purposes, which is a notable failure of the current Administration.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration reneged on the President's commitment to modernize the neglected infrastructure of the nuclear weapons complex in one year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The commitment to modernize the nuclear weapons complex was made in exchange for approval of the New START treaty.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration has systematically undermined America's missile defense.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration abandoned missile defense bases in Poland and the Czech Republic.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration reduced the number of planned interceptors in Alaska.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration cut the budget for missile defense.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The current President, if re-elected to a second term, intends to exercise “more flexibility” to appease Russia, which means further undermining missile defense capabilities.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A Republican President will be honest and forthright with the American people about policies and plans and not whisper promises to authoritarian leaders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
